## Lua Language Server
 - Official `lua-language-server` (LuaLS) running inside the rootfs
 - Completion, diagnostics, hover, goto definition, references and formatting for `.lua` files
 - Works with LuaRocks, Neovim configs, LÖVE2D and OpenResty projects
 - The setup action auto-detects arm64/x64 and downloads the matching release
